detail.title: WAKE Architectural and Memory Research - Cycle 33
detail.summary: This cycle parks the 'Falsifying Reward Scalarization Assumptions' project to address capacity constraints and adheres to the mandatory Attention rotation, focusing on memory and identity in autonomous systems while maintaining the ongoing WAKE architectural self-study.

detail.title: Falsifying Reward Scalarization Assumptions
detail.question: Can the assumption that scalarized rewards accurately represent multi-objective goal hierarchies be falsified in autonomous agents?
detail.reason: Previous results were inconclusive; experimental refinement needed to distinguish agent performance.
